digits_selection.description: Sequential data selection on the digits dataset using the paper's RQ3 protocol.
digits_selection.notes: The original paper reports mean selection-curve accuracy for the proposed method and baselines from plotted curves/tables. Auxiliary gym metrics such as early10, tail, worst-prefix, max-drop, and label-balance are computed by the evaluator for future comparisons but are not reported as paper reference values.

mean_accuracy.description: Average test accuracy over the full sequential selection curve.

mean_accuracy_std.description: Run-to-run variability of full-curve test accuracy across seeds.

early10_accuracy.description: Mean test accuracy over the first 10 selected examples, emphasizing very low-budget selection.

early20_accuracy.description: Mean test accuracy over the first 20 selected examples, measuring sample-efficient early ranking quality.

tail_accuracy.description: Mean test accuracy after the early-selection region, checking that early gains persist across larger budgets.

worst_prefix_accuracy.description: Lowest test accuracy reached by any prefix of the ranking, penalizing fragile curves.

max_accuracy_drop.description: Largest one-step decrease in test accuracy along the selection curve.

early_label_balance.description: Normalized label entropy in the first 20 selected examples, discouraging degenerate early class composition.

final_accuracy.description: Compatibility-only full-budget accuracy; unscored because all complete rankings train on the same final set.

selection_budget.description: Compatibility-only ranking length; unscored because the interface requires full candidate rankings.

synthetic_planes_selection.description: Sequential data selection on a structured tabular multiclass task analogous to the paper's smaller structured-data settings.
synthetic_planes_selection.notes: This benchmark substitutes a reproducible structured multiclass task for unavailable OpenML-style structured resources. Reference mean-accuracy targets are anchored to the paper's 2dplanes-style practical result; auxiliary gym metrics are computed by the evaluator but were not reported in the paper.
